mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_watch_prediction (analysis_id, symbol, market, stock_name, horizon_code, horizon_trading_days, forecast_date, source_price, direction, direction_policy_version, probability, target_low, target_high, expected_return_low, expected_return_high, invalidation_price, rationale, input_snapshot_json, status) VALUES (#{analysisId}, #{symbol}, #{market}, #{stockName}, #{horizonCode}, #{horizonTradingDays}, #{forecastDate}, #{sourcePrice}, #{direction}, #{directionPolicyVersion}, #{probability}, #{targetLow}, #{targetHigh}, #{expectedReturnLow}, #{expectedReturnHigh}, #{invalidationPrice}, #{rationale}, #{inputSnapshotJson}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM stock_watch_prediction WHERE analysis_id = #{analysisId} ORDER BY horizon_trading_days ASC, id ASC

SELECT p.* FROM stock_watch_prediction p JOIN stock_watch_technical_analysis a ON a.id = p.analysis_id LEFT JOIN stock_watch_analysis_observation_identity i ON i.canonical_task_id = a.analysis_task_id JOIN stock_watch_analysis_migration_state ms ON ms.migration_key = 'stock-watch-v6' AND ms.generation = 6 AND ms.status = 'READY' WHERE p.symbol = #{symbol} AND p.market = #{market} AND (i.analysis_scope = 'TECHNICAL_RUNTIME' OR (a.analysis_task_id IS NULL AND a.id <= ms.legacy_analysis_cutoff_id)) ORDER BY p.forecast_date DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.* FROM stock_watch_prediction p JOIN stock_watch_technical_analysis a ON a.id = p.analysis_id LEFT JOIN stock_watch_analysis_observation_identity i ON i.canonical_task_id = a.analysis_task_id JOIN stock_watch_analysis_migration_state ms ON ms.migration_key = 'stock-watch-v6' AND ms.generation = 6 AND ms.status = 'READY' WHERE p.status = 'PENDING' AND (i.analysis_scope = 'TECHNICAL_RUNTIME' OR (a.analysis_task_id IS NULL AND a.id <= ms.legacy_analysis_cutoff_id)) ORDER BY p.forecast_date ASC, p.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_watch_prediction SET status = #{status}, evaluated_trade_date = #{evaluatedTradeDate}, actual_close = #{actualClose}, actual_high = #{actualHigh}, actual_low = #{actualLow}, actual_return_pct = #{actualReturnPct}, direction_hit = #{directionHit}, range_close_hit = #{rangeCloseHit}, range_touch_hit = #{rangeTouchHit}, invalidated = #{invalidated}, absolute_error_pct = #{absoluteErrorPct}, brier_score = #{brierScore}, evaluation_note = #{evaluationNote}, evaluated_at = #{evaluatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
